connector.name: Dynatrace MCP
connector.registryDescription: [DEPRECATED] Dynatrace MCP Server. Migrate to dynatrace-for-ai or Dynatrace Remote MCP Server.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package dynatrace-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dynatrace-oss account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: DT_ENVIRONMENT
env.description: The URL of your Dynatrace environment (e.g. 'https://abc12345.apps.dynatrace.com'). Do not use Dynatrace classic URLs.

env.name: DT_PLATFORM_TOKEN
env.description: [OPTIONAL] Dynatrace Platform Token for authentication. Alternative to OAuth authentication.

env.name: OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
env.description: [OPTIONAL] OAuth Client ID for advanced authentication scenarios. Use with OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.

env.name: OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: [OPTIONAL] OAuth Client Secret for advanced authentication scenarios. Use with OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

env.name: DT_GRAIL_QUERY_BUDGET_GB
env.description: [OPTIONAL] Budget limit in GB for Grail query bytes scanned per session. Default: 1000. Set to -1 to disable budget tracking.
